dedupe_keys.name: refinery centrifugal compressor sensor data from a distributed control system one year 2022

description: This dataset holds one year of readings, 1 January to 31 December 2022, from 25 sensors on a refinery centrifugal compressor, taken from the refinery's distributed control system. The Zenodo record says the sensors cover axial displacement, pressure, temperature and speed indicators, such as turbine axial displacement and oil temperature, with about 35,036 readings per sensor, which suggests a 15 minute interval. It was published in February 2025 by four authors affiliated with Motor Oil (Greece) under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as one Excel file of about 11 MB. Coverage is a single compressor at one refinery. Caveats: there are no fault labels or event log in the record, the sensor tag meanings beyond the four indicator types are not stated on the page read, and the plant location is not given. For simulation it gives real operating time series to train condition monitoring, anomaly detection and predictive maintenance models for rotating equipment in process plants. Related catalogue records include the virtual oil refinery seismic testbed and the Sirris injection moulding drying fault data.
